description: Premom Ovulation Calculator helps users estimate an ovulation day, fertile window, next period, and when to begin LH ovulation test strips from the first day of the last period and average cycle length. It opens an interactive educational calculator in ChatGPT and supports English, German, and Simplified Chinese. The app does not connect to a Premom account, sell products, or direct users to an external website. Results are cycle-based educational estimates and are not a substitute for professional medical advice.

defaultPrompt: When is my fertile window if my last period started August 1 and my cycle is 28 days?
When should I start using LH ovulation test strips this cycle?
Estimate my next ovulation day and period from my cycle dates.
